create_distributed_broadcast: create a distributed broadcast operation to send a tensor from one rank to all processes in a group
create_distributed_all_reduce: create a distributed all-reduce operation to combine tensor data across all processes with a specified reduction op
create_distributed_all_gather: create a distributed all-gather operation to collect tensors from all ranks into a list on every process
create_distributed_all_to_all: create a distributed all-to-all operation to scatter input tensors and gather outputs across all ranks
create_distributed_all_to_all_single: create a distributed all-to-all single operation to split and scatter an input tensor across all ranks
